care.summary: Medium-heat chili pepper for warm outdoor beds and large pots; wants sun and steady moisture.
care.water: Even moisture; avoid drought at flowering
care.fertilizer: Low-nitrogen bloom feed after first flowers
care.toxicity: Fruit edible (spicy); keep away from eyes
tips: Harvest green for classic heat or red for sweeter spice
care.climate_notes: Outdoor summer crop in subtropical climates; overwinter indoors in mild frost zones.
